name: custom-website-builder
description: This is a custom website builder that allows users to create and customize their own websites easily. It provides a user-friendly interface and various templates to choose from.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,frontend "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:api: npm --workspace @custom-website-builder/database run build && npm --workspace @custom-website-builder/node-registry run build && npm --workspace @custom-website-builder/website-templates run build && npm --workspace api run build
scripts.build:frontend: npm --workspace @custom-website-builder/node-registry run build && npm --workspace frontend run build
